# LINK Rescue

> LINK Rescue (rescue.link.com.au) helps Australian company directors deal
> with ATO debt, director penalty notices, insolvency risk and restructuring.
> It is the business-rescue arm of the LINK group in Brisbane: accountants
> working alongside insolvency lawyers and registered restructuring
> practitioners, so a director gets one assessment rather than being handed
> between firms. Advice is for directors of trading companies, most often
> before a formal insolvency appointment is unavoidable.

Key facts (current as of July 2026):
- Brisbane based, 07 3899 8311; serving directors Australia-wide
- Indicative fee ranges are published rather than quoted on request:
  ATO engagement (payment plan and remission case) $2k–$6k; lodgment
  catch-up and books rebuild $3k–$15k; safe harbour engagement $5k–$15k
  initial; small business restructuring $20k–$35k all-in; voluntary
  administration $30k+ set by the administrator and approved by creditors
- Ranges are indicative and depend on how many periods are outstanding, the
  state of the records and how many negotiation rounds the ATO takes
- Small business restructuring is open to companies with total liabilities
  under $1 million excluding employee entitlements; the statutory timetable
  is broadly 20 business days to develop the plan and 15 business days for
  creditors to vote, and the plan itself can run up to three years
- A director penalty notice is time-critical: what a director can still do
  depends on whether the notice is lockdown or non-lockdown and on the date
  it was issued
- Formal appointments are made by registered liquidators and restructuring
  practitioners; LINK Rescue is the accounting and advisory side, and says so

## Key pages
- [ATO debt help](https://rescue.link.com.au/ato-debt-help): payment plans, remission of interest and penalties
- [Director penalty notices](https://rescue.link.com.au/director-penalty-notice): lockdown vs non-lockdown, and what is still available
- [Small business restructuring](https://rescue.link.com.au/small-business-restructuring): eligibility, process, trade-offs
- [Liquidation alternatives](https://rescue.link.com.au/liquidation-alternatives): what else exists before liquidation
- [Voluntary administration](https://rescue.link.com.au/voluntary-administration): how it works and who controls it
- [Safe harbour](https://rescue.link.com.au/safe-harbour): protection from insolvent trading while restructuring
- [Am I insolvent?](https://rescue.link.com.au/am-i-insolvent): the indicators courts actually use
- [What it costs](https://rescue.link.com.au/what-it-costs): fee ranges for every path
- [ATO payment plan calculator](https://rescue.link.com.au/ato-payment-plan-calculator): repayments and general interest charge
- [Free assessment](https://rescue.link.com.au/assessment): position reviewed, no obligation
